bio.text: Jim Pillen was sworn in as Nebraska's 41st Governor on January 5, 2023.

According to the governor's office, he grew up on a farm in Platte County, Nebraska, earned a bachelor's degree in animal science from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and a doctor of veterinary medicine from Kansas State University.
He opened a small animal practice and a swine consulting practice in 1983 and started Pillen Family Farms in 1993.
